# 0004 — Postgres with Drizzle; PGlite for tests

**Status:** accepted · 2026-11-10

**Context.** Circles, memberships and waitlists are relational and need transactions (two people taking the last
spot at once).

**Decision.** Postgres (Neon in production) through Drizzle ORM with SQL migrations generated by drizzle-kit and
committed. Capacity is enforced inside a transaction with a row lock on the circle. Tests run against PGlite (real
Postgres compiled to WASM, in memory) using the same migrations.

**Consequences.** Tests exercise real SQL with no Docker. Migrations are additive first; columns are removed only a
release after the code stops using them, because old app versions keep calling the API.
